title: Foreign
subtitle: 「外國的／海外的／非本國的」，究竟是哪一種 foreign？
description: 「外國的／海外的／非本國的」，究竟是哪一種 foreign？

words.note: 常用於市場、旅客、投資、留學、業務和產品來源，強調「來自本國以外、在海外」。
words.example: The company is expanding into overseas markets.
words.exampleZh: 公司正在拓展海外市場。

exercises.original: The company earns nearly half of its revenue from foreign markets.
exercises.zh: 公司近一半收入來自海外市場。
exercises.upgrade: overseas · 海外的；來自海外的

options.explanation: markets + revenue outside the home country is a classic business collocation: overseas markets.
imported markets 不自然；imported 主要修飾貨物。
通常用於物種、語言或非本地身份，不自然搭 market。
對市場不自然且語氣錯誤。
abroad 通常是副詞，不能直接作 markets 前的普通形容詞。

exercises.original: The university is trying to attract more foreign students.
exercises.zh: 大學正嘗試吸引更多海外學生。

options.explanation: 在招生語境中，overseas students 可自然指來自國外的學生，尤其 British English 常見。
不能用來形容學生，會物化人物。
對學生語氣不自然且可能冒犯。
external students 在某些教育制度可能有特定含義，但不是「外國學生」的普通替代。

exercises.original: The retailer has seen strong demand from foreign customers.
exercises.zh: 零售商看到海外顧客需求強勁。

options.explanation: customers located outside the domestic market are naturally called overseas customers.
不適合一般商業客戶語境。
不精確；可能只是語言或原生身份。
現代標準搭配通常用 overseas。

words.meaning: 來自另一個國家的；外國來的
words.note: 最直接、最清楚的解釋性改寫，適合需要避免模糊時使用。
words.example: Many students in the class are from another country.
words.exampleZh: 班上很多學生來自另一個國家。

exercises.original: Several foreign students joined the class this term.
exercises.zh: 本學期有幾名來自另一個國家的學生加入班級。
exercises.upgrade: students from another country · 來自另一個國家的學生

options.explanation: 這是最直接、透明的來源描述，不加入國籍或法律身分推論。
語氣不當且過度法律化。
external student 在某些制度有不同技術義，不能當一般 foreign student。

exercises.original: The restaurant hired a chef who was foreign and had trained abroad.
exercises.zh: 餐廳聘請了一名來自另一個國家、曾在海外受訓的廚師。
exercises.upgrade: from another country · 來自另一個國家的

options.explanation: 清楚描述 origin，而不必用較標籤化的人群名詞。
foreigner 是名詞，不是形容詞。

exercises.original: The museum borrowed several foreign objects for the exhibition.
exercises.zh: 博物館借來幾件來自另一個國家的物件作展覽。
exercises.upgrade: objects from another country · 來自另一個國家的物件

options.explanation: 直接描述來源，語義完全透明。

words.note: 只有在涉及多個國家、跨國活動或國際範圍時才適合。它不是所有 foreign 的自由替代。
words.exampleZh: 這個會議吸引來自多國的參加者。

exercises.original: The university hosts a foreign conference attended by researchers from more than thirty countries.
exercises.zh: 大學舉辦一個有三十多國研究人員參加的國際會議。

options.explanation: participants from many countries is the defining clue for international.

exercises.original: The company operates in several foreign markets and coordinates teams across continents.
exercises.zh: 公司在多個國家市場營運，並跨洲協調團隊。

options.explanation: across continents / several countries makes the activity multinational, so international is more accurate than merely foreign.
internationally 是副詞，不能修飾 markets 作前置形容詞。

exercises.original: The school has a foreign exchange programme involving partner schools in six countries.
exercises.zh: 學校有一個與六個國家夥伴學校合作的國際交流計劃。

options.explanation: six countries + exchange programme clearly means cross-border/multinational.

words.note: 較正式，常見於經濟、商業、統計和政策語境，與 domestic 相對。
words.example: The fund increased its holdings of non-domestic assets.
words.exampleZh: 基金增加了非本國資產的持有量。

exercises.original: The fund increased its investment in foreign assets last year.
exercises.zh: 基金去年增加了對非本國資產的投資。
exercises.upgrade: non-domestic · 非本國的；非國內的

options.explanation: assets + investment is formal economic language; non-domestic directly contrasts with domestic assets.
資產不是一般被「進口」的貨品。

exercises.original: Analysts separated domestic and foreign demand in the report.
exercises.zh: 分析員在報告中把本國需求與非本國需求分開。

options.explanation: domestic and ... demand is a formal binary contrast used in economics/statistics.
與 domestic 同向，不是對比。

exercises.original: The statistics distinguish foreign sales from domestic sales.
exercises.zh: 統計數據把非國內銷售與國內銷售區分開。

options.explanation: formal statistical contrast with domestic makes this precise.
sales 是交易結果，不是進口商品本身。

words.note: 只適合商品、原材料或產品，表示從另一國運入。

exercises.original: The supermarket sells foreign cheese from several European countries.
exercises.zh: 超級市場售賣來自數個歐洲國家的進口芝士。
exercises.upgrade: imported · 進口的；外國輸入的

options.explanation: cheese is a traded good brought into the country, which is exactly imported.
可指物種，不是商品貿易來源的首選。
international cheese 不自然表示進口商品。
進行式／動名詞，不能作普通形容詞替代。

exercises.original: The factory relies on foreign steel for part of its production.
exercises.zh: 工廠部分生產依賴進口鋼材。

options.explanation: steel is a physical material entering via trade, so imported is precise.
可作名詞或動詞，但此處需要形容詞 imported。

exercises.original: The restaurant uses mostly local vegetables but some foreign spices.
exercises.zh: 餐廳主要使用本地蔬菜，但也用一些進口香料。

options.explanation: local vs imported goods is the natural trade contrast.
不自然修飾 spices 表示進口。

words.note: 表示產品是在另一個國家製造，重點是生產地。
words.example: The policy places extra checks on some foreign-made products.
words.exampleZh: 政策對某些外國製造產品實施額外檢查。

exercises.original: The rules require extra documentation for some foreign products manufactured outside the country.
exercises.zh: 規則要求某些在國外製造的產品提交額外文件。

options.explanation: manufactured outside the country directly defines foreign-made.
不應這樣形容人，且主體是產品。

exercises.original: Consumers can choose between locally produced goods and foreign goods made abroad.
exercises.zh: 消費者可在本地製造與外國製造商品之間選擇。

options.explanation: locally produced vs made abroad is a manufacturing-origin contrast.
更常用物種／語言，不自然表示製造地。

exercises.original: The company checks foreign equipment produced by overseas suppliers before installation.
exercises.zh: 公司在安裝前檢查海外製造設備。

options.explanation: equipment + produced by overseas suppliers indicates manufacturing location.
不自然；標準複合詞是 foreign-made。

words.note: 表示人在另一國出生；不等同「外國籍」，因為一個 foreign-born person 也可能已取得本國國籍。
words.example: The survey includes both native-born and foreign-born residents.
words.exampleZh: 調查包括本地出生與外國出生居民。

exercises.original: The census records how many foreign residents were born outside the country.
exercises.zh: 人口普查記錄有多少居民是在外國出生。

options.explanation: census + born outside the country is precisely birthplace classification.
法律色彩過強，且不只講出生地。
non-native 不一定等於在國外出生。
應用固定複合形容詞 foreign-born。

exercises.original: The study compares local-born and foreign people according to place of birth.
exercises.zh: 研究按出生地比較本地出生與外國出生人士。

options.explanation: place of birth is the decisive criterion.
可能是法律身份，不等於出生地。

exercises.original: Some foreign citizens in the survey had actually been born in the country, while others were born overseas.
exercises.zh: 調查中有些外國公民其實在本國出生，另一些則在海外出生。

options.explanation: 句子刻意區分 citizenship 與 birthplace，因此 foreign-born 最精確。
國籍分類，正是題目指出與出生地不同的概念。

words.meaning: 外國來源的；源自外國的
words.note: 正式、描述性，常用於產品、名稱、人口背景、物種或文化來源。
words.example: The museum displays objects of foreign origin.
words.exampleZh: 博物館展出來自外國的物件。

exercises.original: The museum has several foreign objects whose exact countries of origin are recorded.
exercises.zh: 博物館有數件外國來源物件，並記錄了確切來源國。
exercises.upgrade: objects of foreign origin · 外國來源的物件

options.explanation: country of origin is explicitly foregrounded, so this formal phrase is ideal.

exercises.original: Several words in the language are foreign and came from neighbouring countries.
exercises.zh: 這種語言中有數個詞源自外國，來自鄰國。
exercises.upgrade: of foreign origin · 源自外國的

options.explanation: words + came from neighbouring countries is an etymological/source context.

exercises.original: The collection contains foreign artefacts from several regions.
exercises.zh: 館藏包含來自數個地區的外國來源文物。
exercises.upgrade: artefacts of foreign origin · 外國來源的文物

options.explanation: formal museum/register + provenance context makes this natural.
不如 of foreign origin 自然正式。

words.note: 常用於人、貨物、消息、學生、旅客，語氣自然。
words.example: The university welcomes students from abroad.
words.exampleZh: 大學歡迎來自海外的學生。

exercises.original: The university welcomes many foreign students every year.
exercises.zh: 大學每年歡迎很多來自海外的學生。
exercises.upgrade: students from abroad · 來自海外的學生

options.explanation: 自然、清楚地描述學生從國外來。
from abroad 講目前來源／來自國外，不一定等於出生在國外。
international student 在教育制度中常有特定身份；from abroad 更直接描述來源。
abroad 通常不直接作前置形容詞。

exercises.original: The festival attracts foreign visitors during the summer.
exercises.zh: 這個節慶夏季吸引來自海外的訪客。
exercises.upgrade: visitors from abroad · 從海外來的訪客

options.explanation: visitor origin is the focus, and the postmodifier is natural.
external visitor 可能只是組織外部人士，不一定來自國外。

exercises.original: The shop receives some foreign products every week.
exercises.zh: 這家店每星期都收到一些來自國外的產品。
exercises.upgrade: products from abroad · 來自國外的產品

options.explanation: 直接說明 shipment/source from another country.

words.note: 只在某些制度／系統語境下可近似 foreign，表示來自體系、組織或國家之外；不能一般用來替代「外國的」。
words.example: The economy was affected by external demand.
words.exampleZh: 經濟受到外部需求影響。

exercises.original: The economy was weakened by foreign demand falling sharply.
exercises.zh: 外部需求大幅下降令經濟轉弱。

options.explanation: in economics, external demand can mean demand from outside the domestic economy/system; this is a contextual, not universal, synonym.
副詞，不能修飾 demand 作形容詞。

exercises.original: The company depends heavily on foreign financing from outside its home market.
exercises.zh: 公司高度依賴來自本國市場以外的外部融資。

options.explanation: outside the home market defines external financing.
通常表示物體外表面，不是制度外部來源。

exercises.original: The report separates domestic pressures from foreign pressures on the economy.
exercises.zh: 報告把國內壓力與外來壓力分開分析。

options.explanation: domestic vs external pressures is a formal system-level contrast.
表示向外，不等於來自外部。

words.note: 正式或法律／生物學／文學語境可表示「外來的、不屬於本地的」。日常用於人可能顯得冷漠或不合時宜。
words.example: The island has several alien plant species.
words.exampleZh: 這座島有數種外來植物。

exercises.original: Scientists are monitoring several foreign plant species that did not originally occur on the island.
exercises.zh: 科學家正在監察幾種原本並不存在於島上的外來植物。
exercises.upgrade: alien · 外來的；異國的；異質的

options.explanation: ecology + species not originally present is a standard context for alien species.
可能有人為引入，但原句只說非原生，不一定是商業進口。
表示疏離的，不是「外來種」。

exercises.original: The ecologist warned that a foreign species could spread rapidly in the new environment.
exercises.zh: 生態學家警告外來物種可能在新環境迅速擴散。

options.explanation: species/ecology is one of the strongest legitimate modern uses of alien meaning non-native.

exercises.original: The conservation plan aims to control foreign organisms introduced into the lake.
exercises.zh: 保育計劃旨在控制引入湖中的外來生物。

options.explanation: introduced organisms in ecology can be described as alien organisms.

words.note: 常見於語言、物種、居民背景等語境，重點是「不是本地原生／母語」。
words.example: The region is home to several non-native plant species.
words.exampleZh: 該地區有數種非本地原生植物。

exercises.original: The park contains several foreign tree species that were introduced in the twentieth century.
exercises.zh: 公園有數種二十世紀引入的非本地樹種。
exercises.upgrade: non-native · 非本地的；非原生的

options.explanation: species introduced from elsewhere are precisely non-native.
只適合公司／機構所在地。

exercises.original: The course is designed for foreign speakers of English.
exercises.zh: 課程為非英語母語人士設計。
exercises.upgrade: non-native · 非母語的；非本地的

options.explanation: non-native speaker is the standard language-learning term.
國際身份不等於非母語。

exercises.original: The lake now contains several foreign fish species.
exercises.zh: 湖中現有數種非本地魚類。

options.explanation: ecological origin rather than nationality is the key distinction.

words.note: 只在語言語境中適用，指非本地／非母語語言。
words.example: The library has a large foreign-language section.
words.exampleZh: 圖書館有一個大型外語書籍區。

exercises.original: The library has a large foreign section containing books in Spanish, Korean, and Arabic.
exercises.zh: 圖書館有大型外語區，收藏西班牙語、韓語和阿拉伯語書籍。
exercises.upgrade: foreign-language · 外語的；外國語言的

options.explanation: the section is defined by languages other than the local/default language, so the compound adjective is precise.
書可以是 imported，但題目重點是語言，不是運輸來源。
international section 不必然表示不同語言書籍。

exercises.original: The school offers several foreign courses in French and Japanese.
exercises.zh: 學校提供法語和日語等外語課程。

options.explanation: courses in named non-local languages are naturally called foreign-language courses.
指所在地，不是課程內容。
外部課程不等於外語課。

exercises.original: The broadcaster produces foreign programmes in several languages for international audiences.
exercises.zh: 廣播機構製作多種語言的外語節目，面向國際觀眾。

options.explanation: programmes are classified by language, so the hyphenated compound is correct.
節目可以進口，但原句明說多種語言，語言分類更精確。
表示機構所在地，不是節目語言。

words.meaning: 設於海外的；以海外為基地的
words.note: 表示公司、機構或個人主要設在國外。
words.example: The firm works with several overseas-based suppliers.
words.exampleZh: 公司與數家設於海外的供應商合作。

exercises.original: The company works with several foreign suppliers that are based outside the country.
exercises.zh: 公司與數家設於海外的供應商合作。
exercises.upgrade: overseas-based · 設於海外的；以海外為基地的

options.explanation: based outside the country directly identifies company location, which this compound expresses precisely.
supplier 是公司／人，不是貨物。
overseas 本身可作副詞；overseasly 不存在。

exercises.original: The bank has agreements with several foreign financial firms headquartered abroad.
exercises.zh: 銀行與數家總部設於海外的金融公司有合作協議。

options.explanation: headquartered abroad is a direct synonymic clue for overseas-based.

exercises.original: The project relies on several foreign consultants who work permanently from offices abroad.
exercises.zh: 項目依賴數名長期在海外辦公室工作的海外顧問。

options.explanation: work permanently from offices abroad means their professional base is overseas.
工作地點不等於出生地。
錯誤；用 overseas-based 或 based overseas。

falseSynonyms.zh: foreign 可表示外國來源；overseas 通常帶「位於海外／來自海外」的空間感。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The company imports foreign components. The company is expanding into overseas markets.

falseSynonyms.zh: 一件東西可以是 foreign 但不一定 international。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She works for a foreign company based in one other country. She attends an international conference with participants from many countries.

falseSynonyms.zh: 人、語言或政府不能一般稱為 imported。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The shop sells imported cheese. The university has many foreign students.

falseSynonyms.zh: foreign-born 只說出生地；一個人可能 foreign-born 但已成為本國公民。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is a foreign-born citizen. His passport is now domestic.

falseSynonyms.zh: 例如 non-native speaker 可以是本國居民但不是某語言母語者。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is a non-native speaker of English. She is not necessarily a foreign resident.

falseSynonyms.zh: 對物種可自然表示外來種；對人則常帶法律、歷史或疏離感，現代一般語境須慎用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The garden contains several alien plant species. The university welcomes foreign students.

falseSynonyms.zh: unfamiliar 是「不熟悉」；只有在 foreign to someone 這類比喻用法中才接近。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The customs were unfamiliar to him. The customs felt foreign to him at first.

falseSynonyms.zh: foreign 是形容詞；foreigner 是名詞，指外國人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She works for a foreign company. He was the only foreigner in the group.
